ask_shutdown_server: Shut down the whole server? All VMs and Proxtop itself go off. The power service of the server takes over (e.g. with a grace period and a notification, where it can be extended or stopped).
ask_shutdown_server_backup: Attention: a backup runs or starts soon and would be aborted. Shut down the whole server anyway? The power service of the server takes over (e.g. with a grace period and a notification).
ask_shutdown_server_proxmox: Shut down the whole server now? Proxmox shuts down all VMs first, then the server. Proxtop itself goes off too. There is no grace period.
